title: Standard Condenser Kit W/ Light Wood Spinning Mouthpiece
description:
The Standard Condenser Kit comes with a titanium standard condenser tube, a light wood spinning mouthpiece and all the O-rings needed to install your Standard condenser kit.
Includes
Standard Condenser Kit W/ Walnut Spinning Mouthpiece comes with the following.
1 x Titanium Standard Condenser Tube
3 x Condenser O-Rings
1 x Light Wood Spinning Mouthpiece
